loom.size_unit: warp ends and weft picks per side

accuracy: An exact record matches every candidate-start class for the eight-ring sample, every visible warp/weft crossing in the drawdown, or the total number of Fox 3-colorings of the closed three-strand braid, including constant colorings.
additional_checks: Named worked examples are frozen before the GPU run, scored separately and excluded from accuracy totals and timing.
timing: Median of three synchronized FP32 forward sweeps over all 64 device-resident records in batches of eight after a warm-up batch. Host encoding, transfers, decoding, verification and I/O occur outside the timer.
